sources.query_origin: Korean human-authored KorQuAD questions over Korean Wikipedia paragraphs; official public dev evaluation split
sources.task_adaptation: qa-derived passage retrieval; score-1 seed qrels from question-to-source-paragraph relation; unjudged paragraphs are not negatives
sources.limitations: The GitHub release publishes train and public dev JSON but no hidden test JSON. The release uses all train+dev paragraphs as corpus and only official public dev questions as held-out evaluation queries. Optional malformed answer spans are retained in raw JSON and span_audit.json, omitted from evidence, and do not remove their source-paragraph qrel. The generic quality policy flags 55 dev questions whose positive paragraph has an exact duplicate elsewhere as review_required and excludes those query/evidence rows from expansion-v1; the raw source and canonical input retain all 5774 dev questions.
